incidents.name: 3913 pair surplus skim
incidents.notes: 3913's transfer logic leaves surplus 3913 in the PancakeSwap pair above its recorded reserves, so the attacker repeatedly harvested the surplus with pair.skim() into helper contracts and sold it for BUSD.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0xd74F28c6E0E2c09881Ef2d9445F158833c174775 created 2023-11-01T08:22:22Z by 0x40aef5550b3e23cbc8cd6575598efddd9489854b, which is not the attack-tx sender 0xb29f18b89e56cc0151c7c17de0625a21018d8ae7; 0 EIP-1967 Upgraded events on the victim before the incident; code age measured from deployment (onchain).
